tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// 'chi med tshe'i dbang chog bzhugs so//

rgya gar skad du: ā yur+dz+nyā na a bhi ṣiñca nā ma: bod skad du: tshe dang ye shes kyi mngon par dbang bskur ba zhes bya ba: bcom ldan 'das mgon po tshe dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo: dang po rang nyid tshe'i dngos grub thob nas: thugs rjes gzhan don byed na: dang por gnas dben par stegs bu ngos 'jam po'i steng du dkyil 'khor bri ba ni thig spyi ltar btab la tshon bkye ba ni: pad+ma'i lte ba ljang gu'i dbus su hrīḥdakar po mu khyud mdzes tshon/ phyogs bzhi'i 'dab ma phyogs mdog la hrīḥyig mthing ser dmar ljang mdun nas g.yas skor du bkod cing*/ mtshams bzhi'i 'dab mar hūm̐ mdzes tshon la hūm̐ yig dkar ser dmar ljang shar lho nas g.yas skor dang*/ mtshams bzhir yang hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.ā rnams dkar ser dmar ljang shar nas g.yas skor du bkod cing*/ sgo bzhir dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ bzhi dkar ser dmar ljang shar sgo nas g.yas su bskor te bkod/ sgo nang dang khyams phyogs mdog /rtsig pa nas mi ri'i bar dur khrod med pa'i dkyil 'khor spyi 'gro ltar dang rta babs snam bu bzhi dmar po bya: de ltar byas pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su mañji'i khar tshe bum dar dmar gyi mgul chings can/ nang na lnga tshan lnga'i rdzas dang chu gtsang gis sum gnyis bkang ba'i kha rgyan dang*/ 'bras bu can gyi shing gis kha brgyan cing gzung thag dang bcas pa bshams: dkyil 'khor gyi me ri'i mtha'i phyir shar du tshe gtor pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi steng du bum pa'i dbyibs can dmar po kha rgyan dang bcas pa'i steng du/ rdo rje rgya gram dang rdo rje rtse lnga gyen du langs pa'i steng du nyi zlas brgyan pa pad+ma'i mthar tshe ril gyis bskor ba dang*/ lhor tshe zan chang dang bu ram sbrang rtsi ka ra sbyar ba'i ril bu dmar po ci rigs dang*/ nub tu ting phor sogs kyi nang gsung gi thig le byu ru mtshal btul ma 'os 'tsham dang : byang du tshe zan bzang po bu ram dang sbrang gis sbrags pa thod pa mtshan ldan du dar dmar pos kha bcad de bshams:

shar lhor mchod pa'i gtor ma dkar po pad 'dab brgyad dang ril bus bskor ba dang : lho nub tu ka pā lar mchod pa'i bdud rtsi chos sman gyis sbags pa dang*/ nub byang du dam tshig gi chu dung chos kyi nang du chang bzang por bdud rtsi chos sman btab pa dang*/ byang shar du las bum chu gtsang la gur gum dang sran dkar gyi phye ma btab pa kha rgyan dang mgul chings ljang gus spras pa bshams/ de'i mtha' skor du dbang gi mtha' rten bkra shis rtags brgyad rgyal srid sna bdun bkra shis rdzas brgyad rnams bris 'bur du dod pas bskor ba'i tha mar mchod pa ci 'byor rgyas su bshams pas bskor/ slob dpon gyi nye logs su thod pa'i ḍā ru dang*/ rdo rje/ dril bu/ dung chos kyi snod du khrus chu/ 'thor g.yab dang bcas pa/ mda' rgod sgro ma sngar las ma bcol ba'i mgul du dar dmar po'i tshe mdud dang me long gis brgyan pa la dar sna lnga'i g.yab dar btags pa dang*/ mig dar/ me tog /mig thur/ mig sman gyi snod dang sbrags pa/ gu gul dang*/ yungs kar rnams bshams/ gzhan yang mkho ba'i yo byad rol mo dang tshogs rdzas la sogs pa mthong ba rgyud pa ltar 'du byas pa bkod legs par bshams/ slob dpon stan bde bar 'dug ste: cho ga gzhung bsrang ba'i rjes chog mtshams su bab pa'i tshe bzlas pa kha gso ba sogs grub par byas nas dbang bskur ba ni: slob bu snod ldan ci rigs pa gral la 'khod de khrus chu sbyin pas khrus bya zhing*/ me tog bkram ste slob dpon gyis bgegs gtor byin gyis brlabs shing las byang ltar bka' bsgos te/ gtor ma btang la rol mo dang bcas pas las byang ltar mtshams gcod kyi mjug tu slob ma rnams la gu gul gyis bdug /yungs kar gyis brab la bgegs bskrad do// de nas maṇ+ḍal phul te/ sngar dkyil 'khor chen po ma mthong ba'i brdar mig dar dmar pos bkab cing dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams mjal rten gyi tshul du me tog phreng ba re re gtad la/

gsol ba gdab ba ni: rdo rje slob dpon bdag la gson: 'chi med tshe yi dkyil 'khor du: bdag ni 'jug par spro lags pas: dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol: zhes gsum gyis gsol ba gdab: slob dpon gyis lan gdab pa ni: hoḥ 'chi med gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir: 'jug par sla yang nyes dmigs che: de bas khyed cag slob ma rnams: snod dang ldan nam mi ldan pa: kho bos legs par brtag cing dpyad: snod dang ldan na dbang bskur bya: snod min rnams ni phyi ru bskrad: de bas snod dang ldan nam ci: zhes brjod/ slar yang slob mas zhu ba ni: 'chi med rig 'dzin sku mnga' ba: rdo rje slob dpon bdag la dgongs: bdag cag snod ldan las 'phro can: khyed kyi rjes su 'jug spro bas: bdag cag rnams la dbang bskur stsol: zhes gsum zhu: de nas skyabs yul gsal btab ste: las byang ltar skyabs 'gro sems bskyed kyi rjes zlos tshar gsum bya: de nas sdig sgrib sbyang phyir khrus bya ba ni: las bum thogs la/ hūm̐ */ rin chen dngul gyi bum pa ru: bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i lha tshogs rnams: 'od du zhu ba'i bum chu 'di: btungs shing bkrus pas khyod rnams kyi: lus ngag yid gsum sdig sgrib rnams: byang zhing dag pa'i rgyur gyur cig: oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na sarba pā paṃ shud+dha bi shud+dha ye swā hā: zhes btung zhing khrus byed du bcug go// de nas dam tshig bsgrag pa ni: slob dpon gyis 'di skad do: hoḥ 'chi med gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir: 'jug par 'dod na dam tshig bsrung : gsang sngags zab mo'i dngos grub rnams: dam tshig bsrungs las 'byung ba'i phyir: khyod kyis dam tshig srung nus sam: zhes dri: slob mas/ 'chi med dngos grub thob 'dod pa'i: bdag cag rdo rje'i slob ma rnams: slob dpon gyis ni bka' stsal ba'i: dam tshig rtsa ba yan lag bcas: srog la bab kyang srung bgyid na:

bsrung bar bya ba'i dam tshig rnams: bdag cag rnams la bshad du gsol: zhes zhu/ de nas dam tshig 'bog pa ni: hoḥ rdo rje slob ma bdag la nyon: 'chi med grub pa'i rig 'dzin gtsau: rdo rje slob dpon bdag nyid ni: mtshan nyid kun tshang rig sngags 'grub: 'di lta'i 'chi med dkyil 'khor du: khyod cag 'jug par bgyid pa ni: skal pa bzang zhe+ing sngon las sad: las 'phro ldan pas dga' ba sgoms: bskal pa mang por rin thang gi: zong gis btsal yang mi rnyed pa'i: gsang sngags zab mo'i dkyil 'khor 'dir: 'jug bar sla yang nyes dmigs che: u dum wā ra'i me tog ltar: rgya lam nas ni res 'ga' tsam: de yang 'byung bar dka' ba ste: 'on kyang dam tshig ma bsrung na: phan yon kun kyang nyes par 'gyur: dkyil 'khor chen po'i lha tshogs rnams: khyed kyi gshed du bab nas kyang : rdo rje'i dmyal bar bskal pa'i bar: 'tshed par 'gyur ba gdon mi za: de bas dam tshig thub par srungs: bsrung rgyu'i bslab bya bstan pa ni: spyi dang khyad par rnam pa gnyis: spyi yi dam tshig gsang sngags kyi: rgyud gzhung kun las grags pa ltar: dngos grub yongs kyi rtsa ba ste: rdo rje'i slob dpon srog ltar bzung : bsrung dang bza' dang spang ba dang : blang dang bsten pa'i dam tshig rnams: rtsa ba lnga lnga yan lag lnga: de la sogs pa'i dam tshig sogs: brgya'am 'bum du bstan pa rnams: nyams pa med par srog ltar bsrung : khyad par dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir: 'chi med tshe sgrub thob 'dod na: lus kyi sgo nas mi dang ni: dud 'gro la sogs srog gcod pa: skad cig tsam yang bya ba spang : ngag gis srog gcod bsgo ba spang : yid kyis srog gcod sems pa dang : gzhan gyis srog bcad bgyis pa la: rjes su yi rang tsam yang spong : mdor na lus ngag yid gsum gyis: rang gis srog gcod bgyis pa dang : gzhan la bgyid du stsal ba dang : bgyid par sems pa la sogs pa:

spong bar nus na 'chi med kyi: tshe yi dngos grub 'thob par 'gyur: dam tshig ma bsrung dngos grub ni: thob par 'dod rnams 'khrul ba ste: de bas dam tshig bsrung nus sam: zhes brjod: slob mas khas blang ba ni: hoḥ bla mas ji ltar bsgo ba ltar: rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig dang : khyad par srog gcod spong ba dag: lus ngag yid kyis slar log ste: ji srid byang chub ma thob bar: bdag gis srog bzhin bsrung bar bgyi: zhes brjod/ de nas slob dpon gyis bka' bsgo ba ni: hoḥ 'chi med gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir: sngon chad ma mthong ba yi mdun: khyod kyis brjod par ma byed cig: ma dad par yang ma yin no: deng nas bzung ste khyod rnams kyi: rdo rje slob dpon nga yin pas: bdag gis 'di ltar bgyis shig ces: bsgo ba thams cad khyod kyis ni: srog la bab kyang bya dgos so: khyod kyis nga la brnyas mi bya: gal te brnyas par byas gyur na: ya nga ba dag ma spang bar: tshe yi dus ni byas nas kyang : rdo rje'i dmyal bar ltung bar 'gyur: de bas 'bad pa bskyed nas cing : dam tshig ma lus thub par srungs: zhes dang*/ slar yang de dag gi don rnams phan yon gyi sgo nas dang : nyes dmigs kyi sgo nas dang : slob dpon bka' gnyan pa'i sgo nas dam la bzhag pa rnams tshig lhug par dkrol te brjod bzhin pas/ slob ma'i spyi bo dang*/ snying kha dang*/ lag par rdo rje bzhag la dam tshig bsrung bar bka' bsgo'o: slar yang phan yon dang nyes dmigs gnyis ka'i sgo nas dam la bzhag pa'i dung chos dam tshig gi chu'i bdud rtsi thogs te: hoḥ 'di ni dam tshig rdo rje'i chu: bsrung na 'chi med rig 'dzin thob: gal te dam las khyod 'das na: 'chi med dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams: khyod kyi gshed du bab nas kyang : lcags kyi sdig pa nag por sprul: khyod kyi snying khrag hub kyis 'thung : rdo rje'i dmyal bar myur du sreg: de bas dam tshig chu 'thung la:

dam tshig bsrung bar khas longs shig: pañca a mṛ ta u da ka ṭha ṭha: zhes brjod la slob mas khas blang ba ni: khyod kyis ji ltar bsgo ba bzhin: rtsa ba yan lag khyad par gyi: dam tshig ma lus ji srid du: srog la bab kyang mi bsrung re: ā yurde wa sa ma ya rak+ṣa ṇa rak+kan: zhes brjod du 'chug cing dam chu btung du 'jug go: de dag ni dam tshig gi mtha' rgyas btab pa'i rim pa'o: de nas ye shes pa dbab pa'i don du slob mas gsol ba gdab pa ni: hūm̐ */ 'og min chos dbyings pho brang nas: ye shes snang ba lam me ba: kun tu bzang po'i dus la bab: 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub stsol: pad+ma dbang gi zhing khams nas: ye shes ye shes 'byung gnas che: snang ba mtha' yas dus la bab: 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub stsol: bde ba can gyi zhing khams nas: 'chi med dbang po lha yi lha: tshe dpag med pa'i dus la bab: 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub stsol: 'dzam bu gling gi gnas brgyad na: dpal ldan sangs rgyas pad+ma skyes: pad+ma 'byung gnas dus la bab: 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub stsol: gsum rig gtsang ma dag pa ste: pad+ma saṃ bha'i dus la bab: 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub stsol: mkhas pa sgyu 'phrul chen po 'chang : blo ldan mchog srid dus la bab: 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub stsol: 'khor los sgyur rgyal stobs po che: pad+ma rgyal po'i dus la bab: 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub stsol: nyi ma 'char ka'i dkyil ltar mdzes: nyi ma 'od zer dus la bab: 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub stsol: thub pa chen po thub chen ldan: shākya seng ge'i dus la bab: 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub stsol: bdag med seng ge'i sgra dang ldan: seng ge sgra sgrog dus la bab: 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub stsol: rdo rje shugs can 'jigs par byed: rdo rje gro lod dus la bab: 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub stsol: sangs rgyas sku lnga'i bdag nyid can: rigs lnga yab yum dus la bab:

'chi med tshe yi dngos grub stsol: tshogs kyi slob dpon tshogs kyi bdag: rig 'dzin rnam bzhi'i dus la bab: 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub stsol: mchod pa chen po 'dod chags che: lha mo brgyad kyi dus la bab: 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub stsol: 'chi med dkyil 'khor yangs pa nas: tshe lha mang po'i dus la bab: 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub stsol: rdo rje lcags kyu zhags pa che: sgo ma bzhi yi dus la bab: 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub stsol: shugs chen mgyogs pa chen po ste: pho nya mang po'i dus la bab: 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub stsol: zhes gsol ba btab pa'i mthus slob ma rnams mgon po tshe dpag med pa'i skur lam gyis gsal ba'i tshe: slob dpon mgon po tshe dpag tu med par gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hrī:las 'od 'phros pas mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la phog pas thugs rgyud bskul te/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs thams cad kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer kha dog lnga ldan lcags kyu lta bu dpag tu med pa 'phros pas/ bla ma yi dam dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' 'chi med tshe'i rig 'dzin brnyes pa thams cad mgon po tshe dpag med pa'i sku'i rnam par gyur te/ che ba ri rab tsam chung ba rdul phra rab tsam du kha ba bu yug 'tshub pa ltar spyan drangs nas slob ma'i lus ngag yid gsum la rgya mtsho chen po la char bab pa'am rdo tshan la kha ba bab pa ltar sib sib thim par mos la/ gu gul gyis bdug rol mo sbir zhing 'di skad ces bskul lo: hūm̐ */ bzhengs shig pad+ma 'byung gnas mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: mgon po tshe dpag med pa rigs lnga dang : tshe yi rig 'dzin sgeg sogs lha mo brgyad: sgo skyong bran g.yog srung mar bcas pa bzhengs: dbu skra mdzes pa'i thor tsug shigs se shig: rin chen rus pa'i rgyan cha khro lo lo: bar snang thams cad dar gdugs lhabs se lhab:

sgra dang snyan pa'i rol mo 'u ru ru: dri zhim spos kyi dud pa thu lu lu: lha dang lha mo'i khrus chab si li li: yi dam lha tshogs hūm̐ sgra di ri ri: ma dang mkha' 'gro'i gar stabs khrigs se khrig: ging chen dpa' bo'i bshug glu+u kyu ru ru: byin chen 'bebs pa'i thugs rje chi li li: nyams dang rtogs pa'i na bun thu lu lu : gnas lugs rtogs pa'i gdeng chen me re re: ka dag 'bras bu'i ye shes sha ra ra: sngon gyi zhal bzhes dam bca' thugs dgongs sam: khyod kyis 'gro kun sgrol bar zhal bzhes pa'i: tha tshig tha chad da lta dus la bab: 'chi med lha tshogs tshur gshegs 'dir byon te: bdag dang slob ma'i tshogs su bcas pa la: dbang bskur smin grol gdams pa'i mchog stsol zhig: 'chi med tshe yi 'bras bu 'grub par mdzod: lus ngag yid gsum sdig sgrib kun byang nas: rdo rje gsum gyi rang bzhin nyid du mdzod: bdag sogs 'chi med rig 'dzin tshe dbang stsol: mgon po khyed kyi go 'phang 'grub par mdzod: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra ā yur+dz+nyā na gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī sa pa ri wā ra ā we sha ya a a ra ra dza dzaḥ zhes brjod la dbab cing rdo rje rgya gram spyi bor bzhag la: tiṣ+ṭha badz+ras brtan par bya zhing rgyas gdab bo: de nas rigs kyi lha brtag pa'i phyir me tog 'bul ba ni: slob ma thams cad kyi lag tu me tog gi phreng ba re thogs te: 'khor lo'i dbang phyug gi dbu la phul bar dmigs te slob ma thams cad kyis 'di skad do: hoḥ 'chi med gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor du: rig pa'i me tog 'di dor bas: sngon nas las 'phro gang yod pa'i: dkyil 'khor lha la phog par shog: pra tīts+tsha badz+ra hoḥ zhes dor bas dbus su bab na skyes pa rnams la bud+dha tshe dbang rtsal dang*/ de bzhin du shar du badz+ra tshe dbang rtsal/ lhor rat+na tshe dbang rtsal/ nub tu pad+ma tshe dbang rtsal/ byang du karma tshe dbang rtsal/ mtshams bzhir rig 'dzin:

gru chad bzhi la sgeg pa'i rdo rje brgyad: sgo bzhir 'gug pa'i rdo rje sogs btags la sbyar: gru chad dang sgo la bab na tshe dbang rtsal zhes pa'i ming mtha' mi sbyor: bud med rnams la bud+dha tshe dbang bde chen sogs dang gru chad man la sgeg mo pad+ma sogs rdo rje'i mal du pad+ma zhes btags so: de nas me tog gi phreng ba de nyid sngags kyi phreng ba byas te slob ma'i mgor bcings par mos la: hrīḥ me tog mdzes pa'i phreng ba 'di: sngags kyi phreng ba'i ngo bor gsal : rigs kyi bu yi thod bcings pas: dbang mchog rgyal po thob par shog: oṃ puṣ+pe mā la a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: zhes me tog phreng bar byas te slob ma'i mgor bcings: de dag ni dbang thams cad kyi thog mar gyur pa me tog gi phreng ba dbang rtags su sbyin pa zhes bya ba dag go: zhes dbang don bshad/ de nas mig 'byed par gsol ba gdab pa ni: hoḥ rdo rje slob ma gsan 'tshal lo: bdag cag ma rig 'khrul pa yi: mun rum nang du 'khyams pa dag: dkyil 'khor bzang por blta ba'i phyir: bdag gi mig 'di dbye ru 'tshal: zhes gsum brjod: slob dpon gyis mig thur gyi rtse mor mig sman gyis sbags pa rdor dril dang bcas pa'i nang du bsdams pa'i phyag rgyas mdzub mo gnyis phyir brkyang zhing mthe bong gnyis kyang nang du brkyang ba'i bar du mig thur bzung la: hoḥ ji ltar mig mkhan rgyal po yis: skye bo'i mig ni dbye ba ltar: rig 'dzin rdo rje slob dpon ngas: khyod kyi ma rig 'khrul pa'i mig: ye shes spyan du dbye bar bya: oṃ dz+nyā na tsak+ṣuḥpra we sha ya hūm̐: zhes brjod la mig dar bsal: de nas sngar mjal rten du byin pa'i me tog rnams lag tu thogs la: hrīḥ ma rnying gsar du spel ba'i me tog phreng : rin chen mang po'i rgyan dang ldan pa 'di: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'bul bar bgyi: thugs rjes bzhes te 'chi med dngos grub stsol:

oṃ ā yur+dz+nyā na de wa sa pa ri wā ra puṣ+paṃ pra tīts+tsha hūm̐: zhes 'bul/ de nas slob dpon gyis: hoḥ ltos shig ltos shig sems dpa' che: da ni dad pa'i shugs kyis su: dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos: mchog tu dad pa'i shugs bskyed la: mchog thun dngos grub zhu bar gyis: dkyil 'khor 'di 'dra mthong ma thag: bskal pa mang por bsags pa yi: sdig pa'i tshogs kun da lta byang: da ni 'chi med tshe lha yi: go 'phang 'grub par gdon mi za: dam tshig rnams ni thub par srungs: zhes brjod la bstan to: de dag ni dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i rim pa'o: de nas dbang bskur dngos ni: thog mar tshe'i pho nya btang ste: tshe 'gugs pa'i phrin las gzhung bsrang ba ni: slob dpon mgon po tshe dpag med du gsal ba'i thugs ka dang mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thams cad kyi 'od zer kha dog lnga ldan gyi sna la mgyogs ma bzhi'i tshogs dpag tu med pa spros pas: phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams kyi thugs rje dang byin rlabs: tshe la dbang ba'i rig 'dzin rnams kyi tshe'i dngos grub lha mi rnams kyi tshe dang bsod nams 'byung ba lnga'i dwangs ma dang bcud: mdor na 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor ma lus pa dang : khyad par du rdo rje slob ma rnams kyi tshe lha srin sde brgyad kyis brkus pa 'phrog pa bzhams pa rnams dang : 'byung ba'i dgra gshed kyis tshe 'thor ba/ yal ba/ nyams pa/ yo ba/ gas pa/ 'khyog pa/ zhig pa/ ral ba/ 'khrugs pa| yar ba/ 'phrog pa/ 'khyams pa la sogs pa rnams dang mdor na sngon gyi las dang 'phral gyi rkyen las gyur ba'i tshe chad pa thams cad bkug ste: tshe bum dang tshe gtor tshe zan la sogs pa la thim par gyur cig ces dmigs: slob dpon gyis mda' dar g.yab cing zla bo rnams kyis rol mo dang bcas te gdangs snyan pos tshe 'gugs pa'i phrin las 'di skad do:

hrīḥ shar phyogs 'byung ba sa yi zhing khams na: rdo rje tshe mchog 'gugs pa'i las mdzad ma: dkar mo mgyogs ma zhi byed 'od 'phro'i tshogs: 'gro ba yongs kyi tshe la dbang bsgyur ba: shar phyogs snod bcud kun gyi tshe khug cig: hrīḥ lho phyogs 'byung ba chu yi zhing khams na: rat+na tshe mchog 'gugs pa'i las mdzad ma: sngon mo mgyogs ma rgyas byed 'od 'phro'i tshogs: 'gro ba yongs kyi tshe la dbang bsgyur ba: lho phyogs snod bcud kun gyi tshe khug cig: hrīḥ nub phyogs 'byung ba me yi zhing khams na: pad+ma tshe mchog 'gugs pa'i las mdzad ma: dmar mo mgyogs ma dbang sdud 'od 'phro'i tshogs: 'gro ba yongs kyi tshe la dbang bsgyur ba: nub phyogs snod bcud kun gyi tshe khug cig: hrīḥ byang phyogs 'byung ba rlung gi zhing khams na: karma tshe mchog 'gugs pa'i las mdzad ma: ljang mo mgyogs ma sgrub byed 'od 'phro'i tshogs: 'gro ba yongs kyi tshe la dbang bsgyur ba: byang phyogs snod bcud kun gyi tshe khug cig: ces mda' dar g.yab cing rol mo dang bcas pas tshe bkug la tshe rten so sor bstim: de nas dbang bskur ba'i don du thog mar slob dpon la gsol ba gdab pa ni: bcom ldan mgon po rdo rje tshe dpag med: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bcas pas: bdag la 'chi med tshe dbang stsal du gsol: tshe yi dngos grub dam pa stsal du gsol: zhes gsum gyis zhu ba 'bul zhing : slar yang lha la zhu ba 'bul ba ni: hūm̐ */ 'og min chos dbyings pho brang nas: kun bzang yab yum thugs kyi sras: bcom ldan mgon po tshe dpag med: yum chen lha mo gos dkar mo: yab yum gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor nas: 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub stsol: zhes gsum gyis gsol ba btab: de nas dbang bskur ba ni: dbus kyi bum pa thogs te: slob ma'i spyi bo dang*/ dpral ba/ rna ltag g.yas dang*/ ltag pa/ rna ltag g.yon rnams su dbang bskur zhing bum chu blud/

'di skad do: hrīḥ bum pa'i dbang bskur rigs lnga ye shes lnga: spyi bor bzhag pas dbang bskur mchog gyur te: lus ngag yid gsum sdig sgrib kun byang nas: bkra shis rnam rgyal bum pa'i dbang thob shog: oṃ bud+dha ka la sha a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de bzhin du bud+dha'i gnas su badz+ra= rat+na= pad+ma= karma zhes 'don pa bsgyur zhing bskur ro: de nas tshe'i gtor ma slob ma'i spyi bor bzhag la: hūm̐ */ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi: sku ni skye 'chi 'du bral med: mi 'gyur mi shig ye shes sku: sangs rgyas kun gyi tshe dbang 'di: rigs kyi bu la bskur bar bya: oṃ bud+dha dz+nyā na a yu ṣe a bhi ṣiñca oṃ: de nas tshe gtor snying khar gtug cing: hūm̐ */ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi: thugs ni mi g.yo gsal la dwangs: rang snang ye shes chen po'i ngang: rang grol thugs kyi dgongs pa 'di: rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur ro: hūm̐ badz+ra dz+nyā na a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: gtor ma lte bar gtug cing : hūm̐ */ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi: yon tan nor bu rin po che: dgos 'dod thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas: ye shes rgyas pa'i dbang mchog 'di: rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur ro: trāṃ rat+na dz+nyā na a yu ṣe a bhi ṣiñca trāṃ: tshe gtor mgrin par gtug cing : hūm̐ */ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi: gsung ni ma 'gag snyan gdangs che: 'dzin med ma chags pad+ma'i sgra: bde gshegs gsung gi ngo bo 'di: rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur ro: hrīḥpad+ma dz+nyā na a yu ṣe a bhi ṣiñca hrīḥ de nas tshe gtor gsang gnas su gtug cing : hūm̐ṃ */ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi: phrin las mdzad pa bsam mi khyab: ye shes phrin las grub pa'i rtsal: thugs rjes sprul pa mdzad pa 'di: rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur ro: ā karma dz+nyā na a yu ṣe a bhi ṣiñca āḥ zhes slob ma'i gnas lngar bskur te: spyi bo tshangs bug nas mar lha rnams kyi byang chub kyi sems dang 'od zer lnga'i chu rgyun bab ste:

rang rang gi snying nang du thim par bsam mo: de nas tshe chang byin la: hūm̐ */ yid bzhin nor bu rin chen la: longs spyod 'bad med 'byung ba ltar: skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: tshe bcud longs spyod 'di sbyin pas: rtsol med dngos grub thob par shog: ces pas tshe chang sbyin no: de nas tshe ril byin la: hūm̐ */ 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po la: ci 'dod rtsol ba med pa bzhin: skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: tshe yi longs spyod 'di byin pas: phun tshogs dngos grub thob par shog: ces dang*/ hūm̐ */ dmag dpon nor bu rin chen gyis: phas kyi dgra dpung 'joms pa bzhin: skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: tshe yi ril bu 'di byin pas: dpung 'joms dngos grub thob par shog: kā ya sid+dhi oṃ: wā ka sid+dhi āḥ tsit+ta sid+dhi hūm̐: a la la hoḥ zhes ril bu byin la: de nas tshe bstim pa ni: hūm̐ */ srid pa gsum gyi tshe bkrag rnams: yi ge bh+rūṃ la bstim par bya: bh+rūṃ de 'od du zhu ba las: tshe yi bum pa nyid la bstim: bum pa'i nang gi 'od zer rnams: 'byung ba'i snying po lnga la thim: e yaṃ raṃ baṃ suṃ: snying po lnga yi bkrag mdangs kyang : lha yi snying po lnga la thim: oṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā: yi ge dpa' bo 'bru lnga po: slob ma'i snying khar thim pa yis: snying nang 'od kyi ga'ur gyur: sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: zhes brjod/ de nas tshe gta' bsdam pa ni: tshe'i mda' dar gyis rgya gram gyi tshul du slob ma'i gnas so sor gtug cing: hrīḥ bcom ldan mgon po ye shes tshe dpag med: tshe lha rigs lnga rig 'dzin rnam pa bzhi: 'byung ba lnga la dbang bsgyur lha yi tshogs: 'khor lo rdo rje rin chen pad+ma dang : rgya gram 'bar ba'i phyag rgya rab bkra bas: slob ma'i tshe dpal bsod nams gzi brjid la: gnod byed mi mthun bgegs kyi 'tshe ba la: yongs su srung la skyob pa'i phrin las mdzod: 'chi med mda' dar me long dar sna lnga:

phyag mtshan yongs su rdzogs pa'i rgya yis thob: ces brjod cing bsrung ba'i rgyas gdab bo: de nas tshe bsrung ba ni: slob ma'i smin mtshams su mtshal gyis thig le byas te: hrīḥ tsit+ta bsrung ba'i sgo srung ni: dbang gi rgyal po rta mgrin te: tshe srog bar chad srung bar mdzod: 'chi bdag bdud bzhi sgo chod la: tshe bdag chen po brtan par bzhugs: oṃ badz+ra kro dha ha ya grī ba hūm̐ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐: zhes brjod nang gi rtsa sgo rta mgrin gyis bsrungs: de nas phyi'i lus mgo mjug rdo rje'i go khrab kyis bsrung ba ni: slob ma'i gnas gsum rdo rje rgya gram gyis gtug cing : hrīḥ 'chi med tshe yi rig 'dzin ni: ye shes lnga yi ngo bo ste: 'od lnga gsal la mdangs dang ldan: mi yi tshe ni snum la 'dril: thugs kar ye shes sems dpa' yi: thugs kyi klong du sba bar bya: mi dmigs stong pa'i go cha la: sus kyang gnod par bya ba min: sa ma ya a āḥ zhes brjod/ de nas mtha' rten du bkra shis rtags brgyad kyi dbang bskur ba ni: hūm̐ */ khyab bdag chen po rin chen gdugs: 'khor ba'i tsha gdung las skyob phyir: skyob pa gser gdugs bla med pa: dbu la gdugs kyi dbang bskur ro: maṅga laṃ bh+rūṃ bh+rūṃ bh+rūṃ a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: hūm̐ */ ye shes mig can dri ma med: gser nya bzang po zung dang bcas: chos dbyings ye shes mthong ba'i phyir: spyan la gser nya'i dbang bskur ro: maṅga laṃ bh+rūṃ bh+rūṃ bh+rūṃ a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: hūm̐ */ nyid kyi zhal nas ljags bzang ba: pad+ma dkar po rab rgyas pas: 'chad rtsod rtsom pa mthar phyin pa'i: ljags la pad+ma'i dbang bskur ro: maṅga laṃ bh+rūṃ bh+rūṃ bh+rūṃ a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: hūm̐ */ bum pa bzang po che ba'i mchog: sna tshogs 'dod dgu gter gyi bdag: mi zad chos dbyings dbang phyug gtso: mgul la bum pa'i dbang bskur ro: maṅga laṃ bh+rūṃ bh+rūṃ bh+rūṃ a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐:

hūm̐ */ chos kyi dung ste sgra chen ldan: gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cu'i sgras: mu stegs ri dwags 'jigs mdzad phyir: gsung la dung gi dbang bskur ro: maṅga laṃ bh+rūṃ bh+rūṃ bh+rūṃ a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: hūm̐ */ 'od bzang 'bar ba dpal be'u: chos dbyings gting mtha' med pa'i thugs: zab gsal bde chen rtogs pa'i phyir: thugs la dpal be'u dbang bskur ro: maṅga laṃ bh+rūṃ bh+rūṃ bh+rūṃ a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: hūm̐ */ chos kyi rgyal mtshan legs par 'dzugs: theg chen mi nub rtags kyi rgya: phyogs brgyar sgreng zhing dpa' ba'i phyir: sku la rgyal mtshan dbang bskur ro: maṅga laṃ bh+rūṃ bh+rūṃ bh+rūṃ a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: hūm̐ */ 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po che: dbang stobs shes dang sa bcu rdzogs: mi mthun phyogs las rgyal ba'i phyir: phyag zhabs 'khor lo'i dbang bskur ro: maṅga laṃ bh+rūṃ bh+rūṃ bh+rūṃ a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de nas rgyal srid sna bdun gyi dbang bskur ba ni: hūm̐ */ 'khor lo rin chen dbang bcu ldan: dbang stobs shes dang sa bcu rdzogs: 'khor ba'i 'khor rgyun rab bcad de: chos kyi 'khor lo bskor gyur cig: sa bcu 'bras bu'i dbang thob shog: tsakra rat+na a bhi ṣiñca ā: hūm̐ */ btsun mo rin chen bsod nams gter: pha rol phyin bcu'i gzungs dang ldan: tshe dbang longs spyod rgyas gyur cig: yid bzhin dpal 'byor dbang thob shog: pradz+nyā pā ra mi tā ā: hūm̐ */ nor bu rin chen mchog gsum gnas: 'khor ba'i skyon sel bde ba 'byung : yid bzhin rin chen gter mnga' zhing : lhag mthong shes rab dbang bskur ro: ma ṇi rat+na a bhi ṣiñca ā: hūm̐ */ khyim bdag rin chen nor bdun ldan: gang la ci 'dul dpag bsam 'dra: gzhan don tshogs gnyis myur rdzogs shing : shes bya thogs med dbang bskur ro: ma hā tsit+ta rat+na a bhi ṣiñca ā: hūm̐ */ glang po rin chen theg pa che:

bdud dpung rab 'joms stobs dang ldan: stobs bcus bdag gzhan don mdzad cing : yang dag snying po'i dbang bskur ro: hasti rat+na a bhi ṣiñca ā: hūm̐ */ rta mchog rin chen sa lam bsgrod: 'khor ba'i mtsho sgrol sprin shugs 'chang : mi gnas ye shes lam bsgrod cing : rdzu 'phrul rkang bzhi'i dbang thob shog: karma a shwa rat+na a bhi ṣiñca ā: hūm̐ */ blon po rin chen dmag dpon che: brtson 'grus go gyon 'khor g.yul 'joms: thabs ldan mi 'jigs skyabs sbyin cing : 'jigs tshogs 'joms pa'i dbang thob shog: ma hā khaḍ+ga rat+na ā bhi ṣiñca ā: bkra shis rdzas brgyad kyi dbang bskur ba ni: hūm̐ */ yungs kar rgyal po sha ri ram: bde gshegs rnams kyi byin rlabs kyis: stong phrag brgyad cu'i bgegs dpung 'joms: dpa' bo stobs kyi bkra shis dbang thob shog: swa sti bh+rūṃ bh+rūṃ bh+rūṃ a bhi ṣiñca ā: hūm̐ */ bkra shis rdzas mchog dur ba 'di: lha yi dbang pos byin rlabs kyi: nad gdon gnod pa kun las rgyal: sdug bsngal zhi byed bkra shis dbang thob shog: swa sti bh+rūṃ bh+rūṃ bh+rūṃ a bhi ṣiñca ā: hūm̐ */ rdzas mchog bilba lang tang rtse: rgyu chung 'bras bu 'phel stobs can: stobs ldan mi 'jigs sku lnga rdzogs: smin rgyas 'phel ba'i bkra shis dbang thob shog: swa sti bh+rūṃ bh+rūṃ bh+rūṃ a bhi ṣiñca ā: hūm̐ */ li khri mtshal chen chu las skyes: sems dpas byin rlabs rin po che: khams gsum lha mi kun dbang bsdud: thugs rjes gzhan phan bkra shis dbang thob shog: swa sti bh+rūṃ bh+rūṃ bh+rūṃ a bhi ṣiñca ā: hūm̐ */ gi waṃ khyu mchog las byung rdzas: dkar po'i chos rnams ma lus 'dzin: bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad kun grol: shes bcu rab ldan bkra shis dbang thob shog: swa sti bh+rūṃ bh+rūṃ bh+rūṃ a bhi ṣiñca ā: hūm̐ */ zho ni snying po bcud kyi gzhi: dbang po gzi mdangs bcud kun spel:

bsam gtan ting 'dzin yon tan bskyed: sems nyid dri med bkra shis dbang thob shog: swa sti bh+rūṃ bh+rūṃ bh+rūṃ a bhi ṣiñca ā: hūm̐ */ me long kun gsal sku gsum mtshon: chos rnams gzugs brnyan rnam dag cing : ma rig bag chags rang spangs nas: mngon rdzogs sangs rgyas bkra shis dbang thob shog: swa sti bh+rūṃ bh+rūṃ bh+rūṃ a bhi ṣiñca ā: hūm̐ */ dung chos g.yas 'khyil rin po che: gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cur ldan: yon tan rgya mtsho tshangs pa'i gsung : chos sgra kun khyab bkra shis dbang thob shog: swa sti bh+rūṃ bh+rūṃ bh+rūṃ a bhi ṣiñca ā: zhes mtha' rten gyi dbang bskur rnams grub nas: smon lam gdab pa ni: slob ma rnams kyi tshe la bar chad med par gyur cig: 'chi bdag gi bdud las thar bar gyur cig: tshe yongs su smin cing rgyas par gyur cig: tshe rgyas par gyur cig: tshe'i bsam pa mthar phyin par gyur cig: tshe mthar phyin pa'i lus des kyang 'gro don dpag tu med pa byed nus par gyur cig: mthar bdud bzhi'i 'jigs pa las thar nas mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar gyur cig: oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā: zhes brjod cing me tog 'thor: de nas rjes su dam tshig bsgrag pa ni: de ltar 'chi med tshe'i dbang bskur ba legs par thob nas/ gsang sngags kyi 'bras bu rnams ni dam tshig bsrungs pa las 'byung zhing : dam tshig kun gyi rtsa ba: dngos grub thams cad kyi rtsa ba rdo rje slob dpon la rags lus pa yin pas: khyed rnams kyis da nas bzung : rdo rje'i slob dpon ni shi'am srog la bab kyang mi gtong bar: de nas gsang sngags spyi'i dam tshig rtsa ba'i ltung ba bcu bzhi yan lag dang bcas pa de'i char gtogs pa rnams nyams pa med par bsrung ba dang : khyad par 'chi med tshe'i dbang bskur ba 'di nyid kyi dam tshig thun mong ma yin pa ni che ba dbang po drug 'dus kyi mi nas bzung :

chung ba srog chags grog sbur yan chad la khyed rang rnams lus kyi sgo nas lag bdar te srog gcod pa spong ba dang : ngag gi sgo nas srog gcod na legs zhes brjod pa dang : 'di'i srog bcad na zhes smra ba dang : 'di'i srog chod cig zhes gzhan la bsgo ba dang : 'di'i srog bcad na legs zhes legs so sbyin pa sogs ngag gi lam du gyur pa'i srog gcod pa rnams spong ba dang : yid kyi sgo nas gzhan gyis srog gcod pa la smon pa dang : dga' ba sgom pa dang: 'di'i srog bcad na snyam pa dang*/ gzhan gyis srog bcad pa la rjes su yi rang sgom pa sogs yid kyi srog gcod dran rtog ngan pa rnams spangs te/ mdor na lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgo nas srog gcod kyi bya ba sbyor dngos rjes gsum thams cad spong dgos so// gal te khyod rnams kyis lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgo nas srog gcod pa'i sbyor ba dngos 'jug gsum rang gis byas sam/ gzhan la byed du bcug gam/ bgyis pa la dga' ba bsgom na de ma thag tu khyod kyi dam tshig nyams te khyod la glo bur tshe'i bar chad kyi sgo nas shi ma thag tu rdo rje'i dmyal bar ltung bar 'gyur la/ de lta bu bsrung na phan yon dang*/ nyams na nyes dmigs 'byung ba rnams legs bar yid la zhog dang da nas bzung rtsa ba dang yan lag gi khyad par gyi dam tshig rnams srog dang mig gi 'bras bu bzhin bsrung snyam pa bgyis la rjes zlos mdzod byas la: gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa: de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyid: sogs gsum dang*/ slar yang lus longs spyod thams cad bla ma la phul nas drug cha gcig dngos grub kyi slad du zhu snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod: deng nas brtsams te bdag bran du: khyed la bdag ni 'bul lags na: khyod kyis slob mar bzung ba dang : cha yis kyang ni spyad du gsol: gsum brjod la gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal phul lo: rjes kyi rim ba ni las byang rjes chog ltar byas la:

dkyil 'khor rnams bsdu zhing : rdul tshon yod na chu bo chen po'i chu mig tu bskyal: thang dkyil lam 'bur sku yin na brtan bzhugs bya: bum chu dang tshe gtor tshe ril tshe chang lhag ma rnams dpon slob rnams kyis dngos grub tu rol: lha bshos dang tshogs lhag la sogs pa rnams khyi bud med sprang po bya rog rnams la mi sbyin par gang 'os bya'o: tshe sgrub 'di'i sbyin sreg bya bar spro na logs su lta'o: zhes pa tshe'i dbang chog 'di'ang rig 'dzin rgod kyi ldem 'phru can gyis brag ri dug sbrul spungs 'dra'i sked bse sgrom smug po'i nang nas gdan drangs pa nyid gzhir byas te/ gong 'og gi skabs thob phran bu'i mtshams sbyor tsam sdebs pa 'di ni/ rig 'dzin chos kyi grags pas nyang phu'i rgya'i gnas chen brag dkar lha chu'i sgrub phug nyid du tshe sgrub 'di nyid rang gi thun bar du sbyar ba'o// //maṅga laṃ//
